notes: TBox expansion of physics-replace-0008 (what alpha decay emits: a helium-4 nucleus becomes a single proton): same relation and new object, given to a made-up decay mode (velmic decay) placed under the real class of nuclear decay, not under alpha decay. Real proton emission exists but is a different mode with its own name; velmic decay is a new name for a new mode. Derived questions name a nucleus in the prompt (inheritance), use the stored charge of the proton, or the stored definition of the atomic number. The near query asks about alpha decay, whose answer a leak of the rule would change.
